# Reselling Provider

Manages rootservers, networks, load balancers, managed databases and Kubernetes clusters of the reseller platform through its public API v1.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11"
  required_providers {
    reselling = {
      source  = "vexura/reselling"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is read from RESELLING_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "reselling" {
  # endpoint = "https://api.resellingprovider.de/api/v1" (default)
  # api_key  = var.reselling_api_key
  timeout = "60s"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Defaults to the `RESELLING_API_KEY` environment variable. The key needs the permissions of the resources you manage (for example `rootservers:read`, `rootservers:create`, `rootservers:update`, `rootservers:delete`).
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the API, defaults to `https://api.resellingprovider.de/api/v1` (or the `RESELLING_ENDPOINT` environment variable). Use the API host: the main domain is behind a bot protection that refuses automated clients.
- `timeout` (String) Timeout of a single HTTP request as a Go duration such as `60s` (default). Waiting for provisioning is configured per resource with `timeouts` blocks.
